# Neleus Docs For AI

> Hyperliquid-first CLI and Python toolkit powered by a Rust core

Canonical site: https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/
Repository: https://github.com/auralshin/neleus
Full export: https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/llms-full.txt

Prefer the raw Markdown URLs for ingestion when possible. Each documentation page also exposes AI actions in the rendered site UI.

## Documentation Index

### Overview

- [Neleus](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/): Neleus is a Hyperliquid-first CLI and Python toolkit powered by a Rust core. Use it to search markets, run technical scans, stream live order books, backtest strategies, and scaffold Python trading projects.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/index.md

### Getting Started

- [Installation](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/getting-started/installation/): Neleus currently requires the Rust extension. The CLI and Python package sit on top of the neleus_core module built from crates/pybridge.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/getting-started/installation.md
- [Quickstart](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/getting-started/quickstart/): This page focuses on workflows that work before you create a project.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/getting-started/quickstart.md

### CLI

- [CLI Overview](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/cli/overview/): The CLI is split into two layers:
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/cli/overview.md
- [Market Workflows](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/cli/market/): The market command group is the main no-project surface of Neleus.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/cli/market.md

### Projects

- [Strategy Projects](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/projects/): Create a project when you want to write Python strategy code on top of the Neleus Rust core.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/projects.md
- [Writing Strategies](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/strategy-writing/): This page shows how to write strategies that work with the current Neleus project workflow.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/strategy-writing.md
- [Strategy Examples](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/strategy-examples/): This page gives copy-pasteable examples for project strategies.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/strategy-examples.md
- [Configuration](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/configuration/): Projects use neleus.toml.
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/configuration.md

### Reference

- [Troubleshooting](https://auralshin.github.io/neleus/troubleshooting/): Symptoms:
  Markdown: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/auralshin/neleus/main/docs/troubleshooting.md
